cohort: MCMA twin pregnancies from 11 Northern Survey of Twin and Multiple Pregnancy (NorSTAMP) maternity units between 2000 and 2013 and the Southwest Thames Region of London Obstetric Research Collaborative (STORK) multiple pregnancy cohort
finding: In MCMA twins surviving beyond 24 weeks of gestation, there was a higher survival rate compared with in previous decades, likely due to early diagnosis, close surveillance, and elective birth around 32-34 weeks of gestation.
